name: Carl Öhman

summary.text: Carl Öhman is a Swedish researcher who completed a DPhil at the Oxford Internet Institute (2017–2020) under Luciano Floridi, co-authored the 2018 Nature Human Behaviour paper that framed the 'digital afterlife industry' and the 2019 Big Data & Society paper projecting Facebook's dead users, and published The Afterlife of Data with the University of Chicago Press in 2024.

sources.title: The Afterlife of Data: What Happens to Your Information When You Die and Why You Should Care

facts.claim: Öhman was a doctoral candidate at the Oxford Internet Institute from October 2017 to October 2020, supervised by Luciano Floridi; his 2016 MSc thesis on the political economy of death in the age of information won the OII MSc thesis prize.
facts.quote: Carl Öhman was a doctoral candidate at the Oxford Internet Institute, supervised by Professor Luciano Floridi.

facts.claim: Öhman studied sociology and comparative literature at Uppsala University before Oxford.

Öhman co-authored 'An ethical framework for the digital afterlife industry' (Nature Human Behaviour, 2018) with Floridi and 'Are the Dead Taking Over Facebook?' (Big Data & Society, 2019) with David Watson.
